task.title: AFC-05 truthful health gates and supported audit parsing
task.description: Implement health-spec.md and T11 RED cases. Cover every required source outcome, typed completeness vs findings, supported Bun/npm formats with strict parsing and accurate exit handling, CLI/service/report parity. Scope health only; no dependency updates. Preserve severity thresholds. Add meaningful missing edge tests; execute bounded checks. Read typed task T12-input.json.

acceptance_criteria: Required missing/skipped/disabled/unparsed outcomes yield incomplete absent blocking findings; findings retained and FAIL dominates with coverage incomplete.
Synthetic Bun package-keyed arrays and npm modern/legacy formats parse; unknown/malformed output cannot report clean even rc0.
Strict health CLI/service reject incomplete; optional skips visible and source-filter coverage truthful.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/keryx/.metaproject/index.md first, local task-implementer SKILL fully and testing context.
Own src/health production/tests and src/commands/health.ts/tests only. No package/lock/flow/git edits. No global suite while other RED lanes active.
No weakening policies/required ESLint to get PASS, no real audit/network/model calls. Stats disabled; auto_commit false.

Cross-module gate consumers/types need additive incomplete propagation; coordinate if outside owned files rather than break compilation. Required completeness fixed from policy even with source filters.

Source status available alone is insufficient; distinguish execution, parsing, findings and preserve findings despite incomplete. Unknown JSON or malformed format rc0 is unparsed. Supported nonzero findings is not execution failure.
Write implementation spec before edits, T12-change-report.md and T12-result.json; schema/security validate.
